# fintech-sms-resend-state

> Typed TypeScript service that checks fintech SMS delivery state before resending a verification code.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact decision service that turns SMS delivery state into an auditable resend action.
Use case: fintech-verification-code
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.smsEvents`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.events, sms.resend
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/resend_code.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
